# ssp_bundle (Data Source)

Fetches status and details of a software bundle in SSPI Depot.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the software bundle.

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) The current status of the software bundle.
- `version` (String) The version of the bundle.
